description: Implementation of a Bluetooth IAS (Immediate Alert Service) client in Zephyr OS, handling discovery, alert level writing, and callback registration.

classes.name: bt_ias_client
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth IAS client instance, maintaining connection-specific data such as handles and flags.

methods.name: client_by_conn
methods.description: Retrieves the IAS client structure associated with a given Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: client_cleanup
methods.description: Resets the IAS client structure to default state.

methods.name: discover_complete
methods.description: Handles completion of GATT discovery, cleaning up and invoking callback.

methods.name: bt_ias_client_alert_write
methods.description: Writes an alert level to the connected device.

methods.name: bt_ias_alert_lvl_disc_cb
methods.description: Callback for discovering the alert level characteristic.

methods.name: bt_ias_discover
methods.description: Initiates GATT discovery for IAS service.

methods.name: bt_ias_client_cb_register
methods.description: Registers callback functions for IAS client events.
